description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of exchange with effect from 06.04.2020 to 12.04.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification (General) issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It sets new rates of exchange for customs duties and rescinds a previous notification. This content involves regulatory matters, specifically the modification of financial regulations governing customs operations, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
